# pack-prerequisite-checker

Purpose: Verify brief, runtime posture, skill coverage, and evidence habits before starting a BlendOps workflow pack, then emit a Go/No-Go decision and single next skill.

Block "half-ready" pack execution: confirm the user's brief, chosen pack/recipe, runtime understanding, and evidence workflow are sufficient to start planners and validators without rework loops.

Metadata: Category `routing-and-governance` | Role `pack-preflight-readiness-gate` | Tier `L0` | Routing: `entry-and-stage-routing#3` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- immediately after `recipe-fit-assessor` + `intent-to-3d-brief-writer`
- before first scene planner for a pack workflow
- when user jumps mid-pack without status context
- Trigger phrases: "are we ready to start", "pre-flight for the pack", "what's missing before we build", "check prerequisites"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- Goal or entry point is ambiguous and no pack is chosen yet → use `blendops-help` (`references/skill-blendops-help.md`; Triages ambiguous entry requests at precedence Rank 1)
- Evaluating which recipe or pack fits the user's goal → use `recipe-fit-assessor` (`references/skill-recipe-fit-assessor.md`; Scores candidate recipes/packs at precedence Rank 2 before preflight)
- Workflow is already past preflight with existing stage or artifact inventory → use `workflow-stage-router` (`references/skill-workflow-stage-router.md`; Routes in-flight workflows at precedence Rank 4)
- Detailed Blender MCP runtime connection preflight → use `official-runtime-readiness-checker` (`references/skill-official-runtime-readiness-checker.md`; Inspects Path 1 or Path 2 runtime readiness in detail)
- Active MCP bridge port or add-on session conflicts → use `runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver` (`references/skill-runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver.md`; Resolves port 9876 and dual-bridge conflicts)
- Debugging Blender scene or runtime execution errors → use `blender-troubleshooting` (`references/skill-blender-troubleshooting.md`; Diagnoses runtime or scene failures)
- Auditing external 3D asset license compliance → use `asset-license-checker` (`references/skill-asset-license-checker.md`; Performs dedicated asset license and provenance verification)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `target_pack_id` (`string`): Selected BlendOps pack or recipe identifier (e.g., product-hero-v0)
- Required input `current_brief_status` (`object`): Current 3D brief completeness across subject, destination, and constraints
- Optional input `declared_runtime_posture` (`string`): Whether the session is text-only planning or targets Path 1 / Path 2 / CLI
- Output contract: `prerequisite_matrix_rows`, `go_no_go_verdict`, `single_next_skill` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. identify target pack/recipe
2. run checklist rows from `skills/pack-prerequisite-checker/references/prerequisite-matrix.md`
3. mark each row Ready / Needs input / Blocked
4. only then authorize entry into execution-heavy skills

## Cross-skill handoffs
- [upstream_reference] Recipe selection → `recipe-fit-assessor` (`references/skill-recipe-fit-assessor.md`)
- [fallback] Brief completeness → `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skill-intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`)
- [conditional] Runtime detail → `official-runtime-readiness-checker` (`references/skill-official-runtime-readiness-checker.md`)
- [fallback] Bridge conflicts → `runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver` (`references/skill-runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver.md`)
- [fallback] Runtime debugging → `blender-troubleshooting` (`references/skill-blender-troubleshooting.md`)
- [conditional] License checks → `asset-license-checker` (`references/skill-asset-license-checker.md`)
- [alternative] Domain planner (product hero when Go) → `product-hero-scene-planner` (`references/skill-product-hero-scene-planner.md`)
- [alternative] Domain planner (product grid when Go) → `product-grid-scene-planner` (`references/skill-product-grid-scene-planner.md`)
- [alternative] Domain planner (character portrait when Go) → `character-portrait-scene-planner` (`references/skill-character-portrait-scene-planner.md`)
- [alternative] Domain planner (environment establishing shot when Go) → `environment-establishing-shot-planner` (`references/skill-environment-establishing-shot-planner.md`)
- [alternative] Domain planner (interior architectural when Go) → `interior-architectural-scene-planner` (`references/skill-interior-architectural-scene-planner.md`)

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Preflight gate only — never executes packs, domain planners, or Blender runtime. Uses the 2-path + CLI appendix model per `docs/runtime-stack-strategy.md`:
- Scoring which recipe or pack fits the user's initial idea (use `recipe-fit-assessor`).
- Routing active mid-flight workflows that already passed preflight (use `workflow-stage-router`).
- Writing the 8-slot 3D brief, planning scene geometry/lighting, or auditing asset licenses directly.
- Running Blender, configuring MCP hosts, or verifying rendered/exported files.
